central_results.validation: English proof in article, using the sign bound and Conway simplicity.

central_results.claim: B has pointwise derivative zero everywhere and is nonconstant.

central_results.claim: Genetic primitive uniqueness, RSS Conjecture 53, fails under those conventions.
central_results.validation: F0=x and F1=x-B have derivative 1, equal real restrictions and nonconstant difference; bounded open interval witness also given.

central_results.claim: The entire-genetic sup-property conjecture, Berenbeim Chapter 8 Conjecture 3, fails under those conventions.
central_results.validation: A nonempty bounded sublevel class is the positive finite surreals; all its upper bounds can be halved.
